newsitem.title: UK: Granada hotels sale in trouble - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Granada hotels sale in trouble - newspaper.

text.p: British media and leisure company Granada Group Plc is set to miss its self-imposed deadline of the end of January for selling its 17 luxury Exclusive hotels, the Observer newspaper reported.

The group has so far sold just three of the properties and is said to be having difficulty selling the most valuable, London's Grosvenor House, because of structural problems with the building, the paper said.
No-one at Granada could be reached for comment. The group said in November that the disposals were on track and should be completed by early 1997.
